subject: Avery Tech — quick priority check & proposal request
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@averytech.com>, Priya Banerjee <priya.banerjee@averytech.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & proposed next step

Hi Liam & Priya,

Thanks again for taking the call today — appreciated the time. Quick recap from my side and a light ask on next steps so we stay aligned:

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for your customer-facing recommendations workload while keeping 99th pct latency under 300ms for critical paths.
- Current infra: mixed GPU fleet with long tail on bursts; caching strategy is limited to session-level keys.
- Success metric: pilot target of ~10M tokens/day with 20% cost reduction and <10% regression on NDCG for the recommender model.

Potential fit & proposed next step
- Fit: technical fit looks good for a short proof-of-concept using a focused traffic slice (recommendation gen).
- Proposal: 4-week pilot scope (ingest + inference-only deploy in our Dedicated dev tier) — we can provide configuration suggestions, quantization guidance, and baseline cost/latency report.

Attachments: I attached a short note with discovery bullets and an initial scope template (discovery-notes-AveryTech-0902.pdf). I also dropped a draft pilot scope link in the HubSpot deal (link below) so you can see timelines/cost assumptions.

Ask
- Quick ask: would you mind replying with a line on priority (high / medium / low) and whether a 4-week pilot is something you want to discuss with your infra team? If yes, I can pull together a one-page commercial outline.

Happy to jump on a short 20-min sync if that helps.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
